description: This file contains utility functions, class declarations, and constants specific to the D3D11 renderer in the ANGLE project. It includes conversion functions, resource management classes, and device-related utilities for Direct3D 11.

classes.name: LazyResource
classes.description: Template class for lazy initialization and management of D3D11 resources.

classes.name: LazyShader
classes.description: Template class for lazy loading of D3D11 shader objects.

classes.name: LazyInputLayout
classes.description: Lazy loader for input layout objects.

classes.name: LazyBlendState
classes.description: Lazy loader for blend state objects.

classes.name: TextureHelper11
classes.description: Helper class for managing 2D/3D textures in D3D11.

classes.name: GenericData
classes.description: Holds generic D3D11 resource data with cleanup logic.

classes.name: ScopedUnmapper
classes.description: RAII helper for unmapping D3D11 resources.

methods.name: ConvertBlendFunc
methods.description: Converts OpenGL blend function enum to D3D11_BLEND.

methods.name: ConvertBlendOp
methods.description: Converts OpenGL blend operation enum to D3D11_BLEND_OP.

methods.name: ConvertColorMask
methods.description: Converts color mask booleans to UINT8 mask.

methods.name: ConvertCullMode
methods.description: Converts culling mode settings to D3D11_CULL_MODE.

methods.name: ConvertComparison
methods.description: Converts comparison enum to D3D11_COMPARISON_FUNC.

methods.name: ConvertDepthMask
methods.description: Converts depth write enable boolean to D3D11_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK.

methods.name: ConvertStencilMask
methods.description: Converts stencil mask to UINT8.

methods.name: ConvertStencilOp
methods.description: Converts stencil operation enum to D3D11_STENCIL_OP.

methods.name: ConvertFilter
methods.description: Converts filtering parameters to D3D11_FILTER.

methods.name: ConvertTextureWrap
methods.description: Converts texture wrap mode to D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE.

methods.name: GetReservedVertexUniformVectors
methods.description: Returns number of reserved vertex shader uniform vectors for a given feature level.

methods.name: GetReservedFragmentUniformVectors
methods.description: Returns number of reserved fragment shader uniform vectors for a given feature level.

methods.name: GetMaximumClientVersion
methods.description: Gets the maximum supported client version for a given feature level.

methods.name: GenerateCaps
methods.description: Generates device capabilities based on device and feature info.

methods.name: GetDeviceType
methods.description: Determines the type of D3D11 device.

methods.name: MakeValidSize
methods.description: Adjusts size parameters to valid texture sizes.

methods.name: GenerateInitialTextureData
methods.description: Creates initial texture data for a given format and size.

methods.name: GetPrimitiveRestartIndex
methods.description: Returns the index value used for primitive restart.

methods.name: SetPositionTexCoordVertex
methods.description: Sets position and texture coordinate data for a vertex.

methods.name: SetPositionLayerTexCoord3DVertex
methods.description: Sets position, layer, and texture coordinate data for a 3D vertex.

methods.name: operator== (BlendStateKey)
methods.description: Equality comparison for BlendStateKey.

methods.name: operator!= (BlendStateKey)
methods.description: Inequality comparison for BlendStateKey.

methods.name: operator== (RasterizerStateKey)
methods.description: Equality comparison for RasterizerStateKey.

methods.name: operator!= (RasterizerStateKey)
methods.description: Inequality comparison for RasterizerStateKey.

methods.name: DynamicCastComObject
methods.description: Performs QI cast to a specific COM object type.

methods.name: DynamicCastComObjectToComPtr
methods.description: Performs QI cast and returns a ComPtr.

methods.name: isDeviceLostError
methods.description: Checks if HRESULT indicates a device lost error.

methods.name: ClassifyIndexStorage
methods.description: Classifies index buffer storage type based on state and parameters.
